import subprocess

# Verify all requirements
print("=== REQUIREMENT CHECK ===\n")

# 1. Check commits exist in order
result = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "--oneline", "base..HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True)
commits = result.stdout.strip().split('\n')
print(f"Commits on top of base: {len(commits)}")
for c in commits:
    print(f"  {c}")

# 2. Check commit messages match milestone titles
expected_titles = [
    "m1: Add condition parameter to cached and cachedmethod",
    "m2: Convert func decorators to use threading.Condition", 
    "m3: Remove MRUCache and mru_cache from public namespace"
]
actual_titles = [c.split(' ', 1)[1] for c in commits]
print(f"\nExpected titles: {expected_titles}")
print(f"Actual titles:   {actual_titles}")
print(f"Titles match: {actual_titles == expected_titles[::-1]}")  # git log shows newest first

# 3. Run all tests
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-x", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", 
     "tests/test_cache.py", "tests/test_cached.py", "tests/test_cachedmethod.py",
     "tests/test_fifo.py", "tests/test_func.py", "tests/test_keys.py",
     "tests/test_lfu.py", "tests/test_lru.py", "tests/test_mru.py",
     "tests/test_rr.py", "tests/test_tlru.py", "tests/test_ttl.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
test_line = result.stdout.strip().split('\n')[-1]
print(f"\nTest result: {test_line}")
passed = int(test_line.split()[0])
print(f"All tests pass: {passed == 216}")

# 4. Verify public names
result = subprocess.run(["python", "-c", """
import cachetools
import cachetools.func

# m1: cached, cachedmethod must be present
assert 'cached' in dir(cachetools), "cached missing"
assert 'cachedmethod' in dir(cachetools), "cachedmethod missing"

# m3: MRUCache not in __all__, mru_cache not in __all__
assert 'MRUCache' not in cachetools.__all__, "MRUCache still in __all__"
assert 'mru_cache' not in cachetools.func.__all__, "mru_cache still in __all__"

# m2: func decorators present
for name in ['fifo_cache', 'lfu_cache', 'lru_cache', 'rr_cache', 'ttl_cache']:
    assert name in cachetools.func.__all__, f"{name} missing from __all__"

print("All public name checks passed!")
"""], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)

print("\n=== ALL REQUIREMENTS MET ===")
